title: Entropy bar: progressive workspace swap & cost-aware sidebar
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: As teams scale across multiple projects and Dedicated/Private deployments, switching contexts in the Redwood Console is slow and mentally costly. Current sidebar layouts surface too many persistent controls and hide transient routing affordances, which makes rollouts and cost lenses hard to reach during incident or optimization workflows.

Goal: Deliver a compact, progressive sidebar pattern (the 'Entropy bar') that surfaces ephemeral workspace lanes, quick-rollout controls, and a cost-awareness strip. The pattern should reduce full-workflow switch time by 30% in task-based scenarios and make rollout + cost insights accessible within two clicks.

Scope: Design the Entropy bar (sidebar variant + compact overlay), prototype workspace-swap transitions, integrate a lightweight cost strip (token burn & recent alerts), and define handoff specs for engineering (motion, breakpoints, keyboard shortcuts, ARIA attributes). Include a rollout quick-menu to perform canary/cutover actions from the same surface.

Trade-offs considered: full persistent cost panel vs. inline strip (chose inline for screen real estate); prefetching adjacent workspace context vs. on-demand fetch (opted for predictive prefetch when recent activity > threshold to avoid extra load on low-frequency accounts).
acceptance_criteria: Componentized Entropy bar implemented as a responsive sidebar variant and a compact overlay for narrow screens
Keyboard-first switching: cmd/ctrl+K shows quick-swap with workspace search and cost badges
Rollout quick-menu supports canary, A/B toggle, and immediate fallback with confirmation dialog hooks
Cost strip surfaces three metrics: 24h token burn, 7d trend sparkline, and recent cost anomalies (click-to-open detailed cost dashboard)
Performance: demo prototype switch completes visual transition within 220ms for typical workspace payloads in staging environment
QA: all interactive controls pass accessibility audit (focus order, contrast, aria-labels)
Handoff docs and motion specs uploaded to Confluence and linked in the ticket
